resources.string: Floating button with shortcuts to Home, Back, Recents, Notifications and more

Shows a floating button over all apps, like AssistiveTouch on iPhone. Tap it for shortcuts: Notifications, Control Center, Screenshot, Back, Home, Recents, volume and Lock screen. Drag it to move it. Wacom Explorer only uses this service to draw the button and perform these actions; it does not read the screen or collect any data.
